estimated_recovery_rate: Not established. JBank's 4 December 2025 notice describes release beginning after six months for one International Version path or accelerated release through performance-based unlocking, but the reviewed sources do not establish universal completion or a verified aggregate release rate for affected long-term stakers.
repayment_method: Issuer-described delayed release after six months or performance-based accelerated unlocking; completion unverified.
claim_classes: Long-term stakers with unsold assets affected by the International Version rules
notes: Unknown does not mean no recovery. The issuer notice provides a release mechanism but CYA did not find first-party evidence proving that every affected long-term position had been fully released by the verification date. No static returns were to accrue during the described waiting/unlocking routes.
